LED Moving Text

Support centre

Straightforward guidance for full-screen display, movement, accessibility, permissions, exports, and Premium.

Help with common tasks

How do I switch to full-screen display?

Type your message, review the live canvas, and choose Full Screen. Tap to pause or continue, swipe horizontally to alter speed or reverse direction, pinch to resize the text, and use the visible exit control to finish.

Where can I alter the speed or direction?

Choose the speed and left, right, up, down, or bounce in the editor. A sideways swipe in full screen can refine the pace or reverse the text.

Why is the movement reduced or still?

The app observes the iOS Reduce Motion preference. For complete movement, review Settings > Accessibility > Motion > Reduce Motion; if it remains enabled, the display is calmer or static.

Are brightness and auto-lock restored?

They are adjusted only for an active full-screen session. Your earlier brightness and auto-lock settings are put back when you exit, background the app, or a full-screen error occurs.

Why might I be asked for microphone permission?

This happens only after you enable rhythm response. If access was refused, open iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone. Sound is analysed live and is never recorded, retained, or transmitted.

How can I choose a photographic background?

Apple's PhotosPicker supplies only the image you select. Choose Photo in the style controls; applying a photographic background is part of Premium.

How can I export an MP4 or GIF?

Export is available with Premium. Open the export controls, select MP4 or GIF, and keep the app open during local rendering. You then choose whether to save or share the file.

What is free, and what does Premium unlock?

Free includes unlimited text entry and full-screen display, still and horizontal scrolling, left/right direction, speed and text-size controls, basic high-contrast styles, 5 starter situations, and up to 3 saved boards. A single Premium purchase unlocks unlimited boards, custom templates, the complete font and Aurora Pearl style collection, vertical and bouncing movement, spacing and visual effects, photographic backgrounds, rhythm response, countdowns, and on-device MP4/GIF export. Premium is not a subscription.

How do I reinstate Premium?

On the Premium screen, choose Restore Purchase using the Apple ID used for the original order. StoreKit checks Apple's record and restores an eligible purchase without a further charge.

Do you need further help?

Email support with the steps you followed, the result, your iPhone or iPad model, and iOS version. Please omit private board wording and personal photographs.
